extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Water and shelter — water comes from taps, wells, rivers, ponds; shelter protects us from sun, rain, cold, and animals; types of shelters (house, apartment, hut, tent). (2) Safety — road safety (look left-right-left before crossing, use zebra crossing, walk on footpath, hold an elder's hand, do not run on road, do not play on road), fire safety (do not play with matches or firecrackers, stay away from stoves and heaters, if clothes catch fire - stop, drop and roll, call for help), basic first aid (clean wound with water, apply antiseptic, cover with bandage, tell an adult, for burns apply cool water). (3) Personal hygiene — brush teeth twice daily (morning and night), wash hands with soap before eating and after using toilet, bathe daily, trim nails regularly, wear clean clothes, comb hair, keep nails short and clean. (4) Keeping surroundings clean — throw garbage in dustbin, separate wet and dry waste, do not spit, do not write on walls, sweep and mop floors, clean classroom blackboard, keep garden clean. (5) Care of plants and animals — water plants daily, keep them in sunlight, remove weeds, do not pluck leaves or flowers, do not climb on trees; feed pets on time, give them clean water, keep their space clean, take them to vet when sick, be gentle with animals, do not tease animals. Misconceptions: 'red signal means go fast' (red means STOP, green means GO), 'we can cross the road anywhere' (always use zebra crossing or pedestrian bridge), 'we should put butter on burns' (put cool water on burns, not butter or oil), 'we can eat without washing hands if they look clean' (germs are invisible, always wash with soap), 'plants don't need care' (plants need water, sunlight, and protection from weeds). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function SafetyCleanGame), NOT export default. Export interface SafetyCleanGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
